5292.title: Shell refresh can be masked by a removed machine PATH override
5292.rootCauseOneLine: A removed managed PATH keeps overwriting fresh shell results with the startup snapshot, so child executable lookup still fails after a successful probe.
5292.proposedFix: Define degraded startup and removed-variable restoration policies, then ensure a healthy refreshed shell PATH is not masked by an old snapshot. Verify real macOS login-shell behavior before selecting a retry budget.
5292.caveats: Linux controlled-shell reproduction with real child processes; native macOS launchd, real provider binaries, and the claimed default-timeout incidence were not tested. Main already supports request-triggered refresh with a ten-second TTL, contrary to the one-shot-only claim.
